scientific_limitations_integrity: Only nonempty finite simple 2-regular undirected graphs and ordinary first-order rank at most three. The 1023-case exhaustive computation relies on a proved reduction using Brown–Hoshino; it is not an enumeration of all sizes. Literature searching may miss prior exact catalogues. Primary theorem source publicly dated 30 April 2007; independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
title: Twelve quantifier-rank-three theories of finite 2-regular graphs
